text: Residents have reached out to my office with concerns about speeding along their street and requested that traffic calming measures (speed humps) be installed on the street as a method of addressing these concerns. My office polled the homes and there was strong support from the residents for making this change. I am requesting that speed humps be installed on Stephenson Avenue between Morton Road and Main Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorized the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Stephenson Avenue, between Morton Road and Main Street; and 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway to install four speed humps on Stephenson Avenue, between Morton Road and Main Street, for traffic calming purposes, generally as shown on the attached Drawing No. 421G-3919, dated August 2021, from the Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District.
